landing_badge: Free forever · no sign-up to vote
landing_title: Find a time everyone can make.
landing_sub: Propose a few times, share one link, and watch the answers land. No accounts, no apps, no twenty-message email thread.
landing_step_1_body: Pick the dates — or the exact hours — that could work. Add as many as you like.
landing_step_2_body: Anyone with the link can vote yes, no, or if need be. Nobody has to sign up.
landing_step_3_body: Watch votes arrive live, pick the winning time, and send it straight to everyone’s calendar.
landing_outro_body: Setting up a poll takes less than a minute.
landing_mock_caption: Example poll: three options, four people, answers arriving.
